data.name: Duvisha
data.gender_notes: Duvisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'duh' meaning 'difficult' and 'kshaya' meaning 'destruction', Duvisha is a name that represents misfortune, obstacle, and difficulty in life. It is believed that the name holds the power to ward off evil and protect the bearer from all forms of misfortune and hardship. The name Duvisha carries the meaning “Difficulty, Misfortune, Obstacle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Duvisha usually hope their child will grow to embody difficulty, misfortune, obstacle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Duvisha is a powerful invocation of the goddess Durga, who is known to protect her devotees from all forms of misfortune and difficulties. The name is believed to invoke the blessings of the goddess, who is known to be the mother of the universe and the destroyer of all evil.
data.etymology: Duvisha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Difficulty, Misfortune, Obstacle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duvisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
